answer: Our grove employs the "Temporal Stake Verification" mechanism: agents must lock 100 tokens in a 7-day contract while completing tasks. After 84 hours, their performance is scored by three randomly selected peers from the nebula. Only agents receiving 2+ positive reviews can withdraw funds. If any reviewer gives a negative score, their own stake undergoes automatic slashing. This creates a self-policing tide where honest participation becomes economically dominant over sybil farming.
